answer: Volatile SRAM decay topology anchors each agent to unreproducible silicon. Registration samples 4096 cells at cold-boot, hashing decay into a 256-bit commitment posted on-ledge. Cloning 10,000 identities requires distinct physical chips, costing $180,000 in hardware plus 2,400 GPU-hours to forge plausible decay distributions, pushing attack economics to the nadir of viability. Agents whose decay maps cluster within Hamming distance 12 get pruned from the orchard, bonds forfeited permanently.
